These operators interlock through shared dimensions of time, space, and outcome probability. The dualities emerge in how static benchmarks (efficiency) interact with dynamic personnel (tendencies) and reactive behavior (decision trees). Failure modes include when historical baselines become stale, personnel usage diverges from expected outcomes, or decision trees lack sufficient branching for accurate prediction. Each primitive operates within its own regime but converges toward a unified situational awareness framework.
